Scripts.OnLoad: self:RegisterEvent("CHAT_MSG_LOOT") self:RegisterEvent("ADDON_LOADED") self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_LOGOUT") -- The loot-window fallback only runs where loot chat can be secret -- (Midnight/Forever). pcall: not every client documents these events, -- and registering an unknown one errors. if (issecretvalue) then for _, event in ipairs({ "LOOT_READY", "LOOT_OPENED", "LOOT_SLOT_CLEARED", "ITEM_PUSH" }) do pcall(self.RegisterEvent, self, event) end end
